towns.name: Redspire
towns.summary: Redspire (40.7N 83.1W) is one of the three human 'spire towns' settled on the south-western coast of Marae Lassel after Candeth Martine opened the way in 12 PY, captured by Varicci II's Viamontians 'under cover of night' in 16 PY and still under New Viamont's control. It crowns a green hill (z 44-46) above sea cliffs and the south-western sea: hide-roofed huts, a spire-roofed hall, a meeting hall and a gold-roofed Viamontian stone tower, with a captured-keep banner field where a ring of fire orbits a gold-and-blue Viamontian banner, the Life Stone at the town centre, the Town Network portal and the destroyed portal to Sanamar. Down the western slope the shattered Portal to Nanto, a dark crystal, still crackles with lightning; the Northern Ahurenga Plains portal and the Tumerok caves lie nearby.
